TravelDate.title: TravelDate
TravelDate.description: Preconfigured trip departure date with daily passenger capacity and confirmed booking counter.

capacity.description: Maximum confirmed bookings allowed for this travel date.

bookedCount.description: Current number of confirmed bookings assigned to this date.

isOpen.description: Whether this date is open for customer selection and booking.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the travel date was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the travel date was last updated.

BookingCounter.title: BookingCounter
BookingCounter.description: Global monotonic sequence counter for generating BT-1, BT-2, ... booking numbers.

lastBookingId.description: Document ID of the most recently issued booking or INIT.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last counter update.

DateBookingCounter.title: DateBookingCounter
DateBookingCounter.description: Per-travel-date monotonic sequence counter generating BT-1, BT-2, ... starting from BT-1 for each travel date.

lastNumber.description: Highest issued sequential booking number for this travel date.

lastBookingId.description: Document ID of the most recently issued booking on this date or INIT.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last counter update for this date.

PhoneLock.title: PhoneLock
PhoneLock.description: Per-travel-date uniqueness lock keyed by SHA-256(normalizedPhone + '|' + travelDateId) to enforce one active booking per phone number per travel date without exposing PII.

bookingId.description: SHA-256 lookup ID of the linked booking.

nameHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the normalized customer name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lock was created.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Confirmed customer boat trip booking record keyed by SHA-256(normalizedName + '|' + normalizedPhone + '|' + travelDateId).

bookingNumber.description: Per-travel-date sequential booking number (BT-1, BT-2, ...), restarting from BT-1 on each travel date.

datePhoneHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalizedPhone + '|' + travelDateId for per-date uniqueness lock.

tripName.description: Boat trip name at time of booking.

cancelledAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when cancelled by Admin.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin account entry mapped by Firebase Auth UID.

ContactSettings.title: ContactSettings
ContactSettings.description: Admin-configured customer support contact details (phone and Telegram).

adminPhone.description: Admin support phone number for tel: links.

telegramInput.description: Admin Telegram username or https://t.me/ link.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when contact settings were last updated.

/travelDates/{dateId}.description: Preconfigured boat trip departure dates and daily booking limits.

/dateCounters/{dateId}.description: Per-travel-date sequential booking number counter restarting from BT-1 for each date.

/phoneLocks/{phoneHash}.description: Per-date phone uniqueness locks (SHA-256(normalizedPhone + '|' + travelDateId)) preventing duplicate bookings on the same date.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Customer bookings keyed by SHA-256(normalizedName + '|' + normalizedPhone + '|' + travelDateId).
